## Conflicts

| temp-id | parties | contradiction | proposed resolution |
|---|---|---|---|
| CF-052 | WS-A5 vs WS-A3 (§6.1 versioned references; §6.2 entity 11 `AgentProcess.native`) | WS-A3 fixes `AgentProcess.native{harness_def, profile, control_strategy: ComponentVariantRef, context_policy: ComponentVariantRef, budget, permissions, environment}` — two *named* variant fields — while WS-A5's assembly section keys `slots` by `class_id` so that any registered class (validator, router, memory, compaction, tool-registry policy…) can be bound without a dialect bump. Also: is the Harness Definition a separate document or the HIR document itself? | **Adopt WS-A3's framing** (the Harness Definition *is* the HIR document; the assembly section is the part A3 reserves for A5). Amend `AgentProcess.native` to carry `slots: map<class_id, ComponentVariantRef | [ComponentVariantRef]>` with `control_strategy` and `context_policy` as the Stage-1 mandatory keys (validated by `cardinality = exactly-one` on those classes). Adding a class is then a `ClassRecord` registration, not a kernel change. WS-A3 arbitrates. |
| CF-053 | scope.md R-2.1.4 (C0, WS-A5) vs R-2.10.1 (C1, WS-J1) | "Configuration & composition model" is C0 while "Harness assembly & declarative definition; validation against the IR" is C1, yet the assembly grammar and `validate_assembly` must exist at Stage 1 for Stage-0/1 harnesses to be defined at all. | Split: the **grammar, `load/compose/resolve/validate_assembly/identity/instantiate/verify_resume` contracts** are C0/Stage 1 (R-2.1.4, this dossier); the **assembly service, registry service, discovery/UI and `space/enumerate` scheduling** are C1 (R-2.10.1/R-2.10.2, WS-J1/J2). Scope register annotation only; no tier change. |
| CF-054 | Ontology v0.1 §5 "Harness Definition" ("names component variants, parameters, **profiles** and policies") vs ontology `configuration` (profile is a separate coordinate of model × harness def × profile × environment × budget × seed) | If a Harness Definition *names* its profile, the profile is not an independent factor and T-LCD-04 ("one IR definition compiles to ≥2 profiles") is contradicted. | `profile_binding` is **unbound by default**; a definition may *constrain* the admissible profile set (`ProfileConstraint`) and pinning is OQ-078. Ontology wording amendment: "names component variants, parameters and policies, and may constrain profiles". WS-A2 at v1. |
| CF-055 | WS-A5 ("definitions contain no code") vs WS-H5/WS-L5 (hooks, exec-policy leaves, skills with scripts, third-party plugins) | Hooks and policy DSLs are data that *contain* or *name* executables; a strict "no code" reading would exclude them, a loose one re-opens the DSPy/AutoGen "load arbitrary code" path. | **Pointer rule:** a definition names executables only by versioned identity (resolved to a content address + trust record) or as a WS-A3 `CompiledPayload` leaf with a declared interface; executables run only through a Core-declared effect class and permission (WS-H5/L5); interpreted leaves are OQ-077. H5/L5 confirm the trust-record shape in Phase 2. |
| CF-056 | WS-A5 `resolve` vs WS-A4 §6.1 stage 1 `link` ("binds every component-class slot to a variant (class, version, content hash); resolves the profile chain … and target spec versions; resolves policy/budget/validator references") | Two operations claim to bind slots to variants; two resolvers would let a compiler-side resolution diverge from the sealed definition the Lab keys results by. | **One resolver, two callers:** WS-A5 `resolve` produces the sealed definition (variant/entity refs pinned; `registry_snapshot_id`); WS-A4 `link` *consumes* a sealed definition, resolves only what A5 does not own (profile chain, target spec versions), and refuses unpinned selectors with `LinkError{unbound_slot}` (WS-A5 AC-10). WS-A4 stage 0 calls `validate_assembly`. Phase 1 synthesis to record in both ADRs. |

## Ontology terms

| term | definition | notes |
|---|---|---|
| **assembly (section)** | The part of a Harness Definition (HIR document) that names slot bindings, the declared parameter space, parameter values, entity references, constraints, layer provenance and the extension slot; the composer's input; the only place unpinned version selectors are legal (WS-A3 §6.1). | WS-A5 / WS-A3 / WS-J1. Precedent: OpenHands `AgentProfile`, goose `Recipe`, Omnigent agent YAML. |
| **component slot** | A named plug point of a Harness Definition keyed by `class_id`, filled by one (or, for `ordered-many` classes, an ordered list of) slot binding(s); its cardinality is fixed by the `ClassRecord`. | WS-A5 / WS-J2. |
| **slot binding** | `SlotBinding{variant: ComponentVariantRef, params, enabled, locality?}` — the record that fills a component slot; `enabled=false` is the canonical whole-component ablation switch. | WS-A5 / WS-J3. Precedent: goose `ExtensionEntry{enabled, ..}`. |
| **`ComponentVariantRef`** | `{class_id, variant_id, version_selector | version_id}`; authored form may carry a selector (name, range, deny-list), sealed form must carry a `version_id` (content address of the `VariantRecord`). Named by WS-A3 §6.2 as a reference type; defined here. | WS-A5 / WS-A3 / WS-L4. Precedent: AutoGen `ComponentModel{provider, component_type, version, component_version}`; OpenHands `ResolvedPluginSource.resolved_ref`. |
| **variant record** | The registry row for one component variant: `{variant_id, class_id, version, version_id, param_schema, implementation (CompiledPayload | entrypoint + locality), capability_declaration, conditioned_rules[AssumptionDebtRecord], provenance/trust, dialect_range}`. | WS-A5 / WS-J2 / WS-L5. Precedent: AutoGen `ComponentModel`; Agent Spec `min/max_agentspec_version`. |
| **definition layer / layer provenance** | A fragment of an assembly plus `LayerProvenance{source_kind ∈ {packaged-default, organisation, user, project, experiment, session}, id, version, precedence}`; `compose` merges layers per-field and records the winning source per path. | WS-A5 / WS-J3 / WS-H1. Precedent: Codex `ConfigLayer{name, version, config, disabled_reason}`; opencode `plugin_origins`. |
| **authority cap** | A `Constraint{kind: authority_cap}` from a layer: a monotone bound on a permission/budget/effect set that lower-precedence layers (including the experiment layer) may only narrow, never widen; violation is `AuthorityViolation`. | WS-A5 / WS-H1 / WS-L3 (CF-006 label scheme). Precedent: Codex `Constrained<T>`/`Sourced<T>`; Claude Code security-key "stricter value wins". |
| **parameter space / parameter spec** | The declared, typed set of sweepable axes of a Harness Definition: `parameters: {id: ParameterSpec{type, domain, default, required, unit, sweepable, affects, budget_relevant}}` plus the registered variants per slot; `space()` derives it, `enumerate()` produces sealed definitions from it. | WS-A5 / WS-J3. Precedent: goose `RecipeParameter`; Claude plugins `userConfig`. |
| **configuration override** | One edit to an assembly in the Hydra-class grammar (`path=v`, `+path=v`, `++path=v`, `~path`, `path=v1,v2` choice sweep; `class_id=variant_id` slot override); applied as an `experiment` layer; every result passes `validate_assembly`. | WS-A5 / WS-J3. |
| **code-pointer leaf** | A data value that names an executable by versioned identity (package, path, module, command) and is resolved at `resolve` time to a content address + trust record; never an inline body; executed only through a declared effect class and permission. | WS-A5 / WS-L5 / WS-H5. Precedent: Pi `packages`/`pi` manifest; opencode plugin `Origin`; DSPy `save_program` (the path to avoid). |
| **migration ladder** | The ordered promotion path for a behaviour: prose → typed `Text` leaf with provenance → typed parameter or entity → registered variant → Core invariant (ADR only); demotion/retirement runs the other way via assumption-debt expiry (T-LCD-05). | WS-A5 / WS-I5 / WS-I6. Evidence: S-074 "policy migrated out of prose" (mechanism). |
| **binding locality** | A property of a *variant registration* (never of a class contract): `in-process | out-of-process | remote`; the `SlotBinding.locality` field is a hint; contracts are locality-neutral (T-LCD-12). | WS-A5 / WS-L5 / WS-L2. Precedent: goose `ExtensionConfig::{Platform, Stdio, StreamableHttp}` under one tag set. |
| **component binding event** | Proposed WS-B1 event class `lifecycle.component.bound{slot, class_id, variant_ref, locality, bind_result}` emitted by `instantiate` for every slot, making the run's instance graph observable and attributable. | WS-A5 / WS-B1 (OQ-079). |
